class Field { value = 1; }
class FieldToGetter extends Field { get value() { return 2; } }
class Getter { get value() { return 1; } }
class GetterToField extends Getter { value = 2; }
class FieldToSetter extends Field { set value(next: number) {} }
class Param { constructor(public value: number) {} }
class ParamToAccessors extends Param { get value() { return 1; } set value(next: number) {} }
class AccessorToParam extends Getter { constructor(public value: number) { super(); } }
abstract class AbstractField { abstract value: number; }
class AbstractToGetter extends AbstractField { get value() { return 1; } }
class Method { run() { return 1; } }
class MethodToGetter extends Method { get run() { return () => 2; } }
class MethodToField extends Method { run = () => 3; }
class Redeclared extends Field { value!: number; }
class Assigned extends Field { value: number; constructor() { super(); this.value = 4; } }
class Overridden extends Getter { get value() { return 5; } }
console.log(new Overridden().value, new Assigned().value, new MethodToField().run());
